source_units.text: Explain a metadata convention for an invented catalog.
Keep the complete piece to 55–85 words.
Use this fictional material: The catalog uses maker unknown when attribution is missing and date not recorded when no creation date survives.
Explain that blank is not a value because empty cells could also mean unfinished work.
Required wording, verbatim: "maker unknown", "date not recorded", "blank is not a value".
The audience is editors of an invented object catalog.
